SRC_API_PART2_VOL2_2008.name: Ksharasutra

indication_details.preparation: Medicated linen thread coated with 21 coatings of Snuhi, Apamarga Kshara, and Haridra
indication_details.source_dosage: Procedural application by qualified Ayurvedic surgeon

SRC_API_PART2_VOL2_2008.preparation_method: Surgical linen thread size 20 coated in Ksharasutra cabinet: 11 coatings Snuhi latex, 7 coatings Snuhi + Apamarga Kshara, 3 coatings Snuhi + Haridra powder (total 21 coatings), UV sterilized.
SRC_API_PART2_VOL2_2008.source_dosage_info: Surgical seton application under clinical protocol; thread changed weekly by surgeon.
warnings: Procedural device; requires specialized operative technique under aseptic conditions.
contraindications: Sinuses connected with osteomyelitis of pelvic bones or femur
Tuberculosis of hip joint or spine
safety_notes: Strictly contraindicated in osteomyelitis, TB spine/hip, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis, and pelvic malignancies. Competent surgeon decision required.
limitations: Procedural surgical intervention; cannot be self-administered or prescribed as an OTC home remedy

provenance.document_title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part - II, Vol - II
provenance.excerpt: Therapeutic uses: Bhagandara (Fistula-in-ano), Nadivrana (sinuses), Arsa (haemorrhoids). Contraindications: Sinuses connected with Osteomyelitis, TB of hip/spine, Ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, pelvic malignancies. Note: Competent surgeon should make judicious decision.
